definitions.text: A substance that increases the rate of a reaction without modifying the overall standard Gibbs energy change in the reaction; the process is called catalysis. The catalyst is both a reactant and product of the reaction.

notes.1: Catalysis can be homogeneous or heterogeneous, in which the reaction occurs at or near an interface between phases.
notes.2: Catalysis brought about by one of the products of a reaction is called autocatalysis.
